name: daemon_control
description: Wraps core/daemon.py's read-only status queries and single-task cancellation as CCOS capabilities, post-'PENDING_ISH_DECISIONS.md item 2' daemon-control redesign. The socket 'shutdown' handler and its daemon_shutdown() helper no longer exist at all (retired by 7.4/4.1 sub-task D) — the daemon now shuts itself down only via an autonomous thermal/CPU tripwire, with no agent- or user-triggerable equivalent. Deliberately does NOT expose the socket 'command' handler (enqueues a prompt for later pull-side planning + dispatch) — item 2's redesign changed WHEN the resulting real 7B inference/tool execution happens, not whether an agent-triggered call still causes it as an unreviewed side effect; same risk class as core/lora_import.py's swap_to_finetuned_model in coding.finetune. Also does NOT expose the socket 'release_model_slot' handler — not a risk-tier case, but an internal CLI-to-daemon resource-coordination primitive (main.py's own model-load retry path) with no use case for any of the five deliberation-loop agents or the coding agent. core/observability.py's status() is already wrapped separately as system.observability_full_status in ccos/plugins/system/observability/ — not duplicated here.

capabilities.name: system.daemon_check_pid_file
capabilities.description: Read-only: check whether a daemon PID file indicates another daemon instance is running (self-healing: removes a stale PID file if the process is dead)

capabilities.name: system.daemon_is_running
capabilities.description: Read-only: check whether the daemon is running by probing its Unix socket

capabilities.name: system.daemon_ping
capabilities.description: Read-only: liveness check against the running daemon

capabilities.name: system.daemon_status
capabilities.description: Read-only: daemon status (PID, pending/running/done task counts, state snapshot)

capabilities.name: system.daemon_health
capabilities.description: Read-only: daemon health check (uptime, memory, stuck tasks, recent action count)

capabilities.name: system.daemon_get_task
capabilities.description: Read-only: look up a specific task by ID, or list recent tasks if no ID is given

capabilities.name: system.daemon_cancel_task
capabilities.description: Cancel one pending task by ID. Scoped to a single task — does not affect the daemon process or any other queued task.

author: CCOS
